title: 2D Adaptive with the stock as source clears the part's own section (generate says ok, only verify stops it); a band narrower than the tool is skipped silently

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found while programming a simple 2.5D end-cap plate (user's project) with the CamCraft **v0.19.0** release CLI (macOS arm64), driven headlessly over MCP. Re-checked on upstream main **d00243a5** (`camcraft-cli` built from it): **still reproduces, identical output**.

The user's part: a FreeCAD plate 101.6 x 177.4 x 10 mm with a Ø74.3 mm through bore and 4 x Ø6 mm through holes, in a box stock 0.125 in larger per side. The aim was to rough the outside of the part with a 2D Adaptive whose source is the stock (as on an earlier project).

## What happens

A 2D Adaptive with `source: "stock"` and no geometry picks clears the **whole stock footprint**, the part included, to full depth. `generate` reports the op `ok` with no warning and no note. Only `verify` catches it, and blocks the post:

- the user's plate: `gouge: program cuts below the model in 85918 cell(s), worst 11.02 mm`. Same with an exclude boundary on the bore, and with the part unrotated.
- the minimal repro below (a plain 100 x 60 x 10 box, no bore at all): `gouge: program cuts below the model in 42560 cell(s), worst 9.00 mm at (-49.69, -29.69, z 1.00)`. With a centred Ø40 bore in it: 33634 cells, worst 9.00 mm. 1066 of the 1740 feed points sit inside the part outline below its top.

Nothing unsafe is posted (verify holds the post). But generate hands back a path that cuts through the part and calls it `ok`.

**Second finding, same goal (rough a plate's outside in a slightly larger stock).** With `source: "plate"` (the model) the adaptive does protect the part. But when the stock margin is narrower than the tool (3.175 mm per side with a 6 mm tool, the user's 0.125 in), the outside band is **dropped silently**: the op comes back `ok` with no note and no warnings, and every one of its 51,188 feed points is inside the bore; the outside is not cut at all. The user's attempt to limit the adaptive to that band with picks was refused instead: `pocket is narrower than the tool`. An outside band is open to air on its outer side, so a tool wider than the band can still cut it (one pass along the part, hanging over the stock edge).

## Minimal repro (MCP)

`plate.stl`: a closed 100 x 60 x 10 mm box, centred in XY, z 0..10 (12 facets).

```
import_model   {"path": "plate.stl", "name": "plate"}
add_setup      {"name": "Setup 1"}
set_stock      {"box": {"dx": 120, "dy": 80, "dz": 12}}
set_wcs        {"stock_point": {"x": "center", "y": "center", "z": "max"}}
add_tool       {"catalog": "EM-0600-4FL", "name": "EM6"}
add_operation  {"kind": "2D Adaptive", "tool": "EM6", "name": "outside rough", "source": "stock",
                "params": {"top_z": {"reference": "top_of_stock", "offset": 0},
                           "bottom_z": {"reference": "top_of_stock", "offset": -11}, "stepdown": 4}}
generate {}   -> status "ok", 882 moves, 0 warnings
verify {}     -> ok: false, "gouge: program cuts below the model in 42560 cell(s), worst 9.00 mm ..."
```

Same calls with `"source": "plate"`: 318 moves, all outside the part, verify clean (the expected behaviour). With `"source": "plate"`, a Ø40 bore in the plate and the stock at 106.35 x 66.35 (3.175 mm margin): `ok`, no note, the outside not cut.

## Expected

- A stock-sourced 2D Adaptive in a setup that holds a part never machines the part's own section: it roughs the stock minus the part (the outside band, and nothing inside the part outline unless picked), or it refuses at generate by name ("the stock source covers the part - pick the area or use the model as the source"). Compare #12 (the same law for a whole-model Pocket source) and #3.
- An outside band narrower than the tool is still roughed (the tool may hang over the open stock edge), or the op says plainly that the band was skipped and why. Never a silent `ok` that left the outside uncut.

## Done means

- The minimal repro above (stock source, plain box) generates a path with no cut inside the part outline below its top, or is refused at generate with a message naming the cause; pinned by a test.
- A model-sourced adaptive with a stock margin narrower than the tool either cuts the band or carries a note/warning naming the skipped band; pinned by a test.
- `verify` stays the backstop; no existing gouge pin is loosened.

Related: #12, #3, #1446.
